title: 2026 Billboard Women in Music Red Carpet: The Best Photos
summary: See this year’s Billboard Women in Music Awards attendees pictured on the red carpet in our gallery of can’t-miss moments.
contentText:
The 2026 Billboard Women in Music awards ceremony is a big night for the most influential women in music. The annual event, which honors accomplished women and their contributions to the music industry, is going down Wednesday (April 29) at the Hollywood Palladium in Los Angeles.

Host Keke Palmer, some of the biggest names in music and industry leaders graced the red carpet ahead of the ceremony. See the best red carpet photos from the night here.

Artist honorees at this year’s Billboard Women in Music include Teyana Taylor, receiving the Visionary Award; Zara Larsson, receiving the Breakthrough Award; and KPop Demon Hunters ’ HUNTR/X singing voices (EJAE, AUDREY NUNA and REI AMI) receiving the Women of the Year Award. Other honorees include Thalia (Icon Award), Kehlani (Impact Award), Laufey (Innovator Award), Mariah the Scientist (Rising Star Award) and Tate McRae (Hitmaker Award).

International superstars BINI and The Beaches are receiving the new Global Force awards presented by Billboard Philippines and Billboard Canada, respectively.

The 2026 executive honorees are led by Executive of the Year Elizabeth Matthews, CEO of the American Society of Composers, Authors and Publishers (ASCAP), a performing rights organization that licenses, collects fees, tracks and distributes royalties to its 1.1 million music industry members.

This year’s list of presenters is as stacked as the awardees. The presenter lineup features stars like the 2025 Impact Award winner Tyla, Brandi Carlile, Cara Delevingne, Ciara, Coco Jones and more.
